findings.current: They were arsonists who deserved to burn.
findings.defect: Softens Jeok Cheongang’s anger: burning them to death would not have satisfied him, rather than being a fitting punishment.
findings.rationale: 태워 죽여도 시원치 않을 says that even burning them to death would not have been enough.
findings.replacement: They were arsonists I wouldn’t have been satisfied with even if I’d burned them alive.

findings.current:
“Why?”

He struggled as if he might shake off the palace attendants’ hands at any moment and rush onto the battlefield.

“Why would you do this?”
findings.defect: Changes the prince’s repeated, incredulous demand about what the Emperor is thinking into questions about a deed.
findings.rationale: 무슨 생각이신 겁니까 challenges the Emperor’s thinking amid his refusal to intervene; the preceding 도대체 begins the same outburst.
findings.replacement:
“What on earth—”

He struggled as if he might shake off the palace attendants’ hands at any moment and rush onto the battlefield.

“What on earth are you thinking?”
findings.source:
“도대체!”

당장이라도 자신을 붙잡은 궁인들의 손을 뿌리치고 전장으로 달려 나갈 듯이 몸부림치며.

“도대체 무슨 생각이신 겁니까!”

findings.current: “If there is anything you wish of me, I will do it. If you order me to leave the Great Nation, I will obey. But please, do not refuse this one request—my first and last.”
findings.defect: Omits both self-references as the Emperor’s younger brother, flattening the familial appeal that immediately precedes the Emperor’s unspoken wish to be called older brother.
findings.rationale: 소제 and 이 아우 both explicitly identify the speaker as the Emperor’s younger brother.
findings.replacement: “If there is anything you wish of me, I will do it. If you order your younger brother to leave the Great Nation, I will obey. But please, do not refuse this request from your brother—the first and last I will ever make of you.”
findings.source: “원하시는 바가 있다면 무엇이든 하겠습니다. 소제(小弟)더러 대국을 떠나라 하시면, 그 역시 명을 따르겠습니다. 다만 이 아우가 처음이자 마지막으로 드리는 부탁만큼은 거절하지 마시옵소서.”

findings.defect: “Spare him” suggests withholding punishment or an intended killing; the prince is asking the Emperor to save a friend caught in the fighting.
findings.rationale: 살려 주십시오 asks for his life to be saved, and the prince has just seen Jin Taekyung struggling on the battlefield.

findings.defect: Formats a remembered spoken question as a direct thought.
findings.rationale: The narration calls it a question the prince put to Jin Taekyung, who answered aloud.

summary: The draft preserves the battle’s main sequence, but it weakens Jeok Cheongang’s threat and loses key cues in Prince Shangshan’s plea.
